title: someone starts something without opening a shop

criteria.text: A Member with no Page can create a hosted gathering: no business record, no document, ID or ZIP check; the F082 rules agreement is the only thing before publish
criteria.note: Create's 'Do you manage a group or meetup…?' (gather) calls `startDraftAction` → `group.create` with kind group, no `group_businesses` row, no ID or ZIP field; `group.activate` needs name, place, description, a tag and the F082 agreement [V src/app/create/actions.ts, actions/group/create.ts, activate.ts]. Built by #326 (Reviewed by) and #364 (review-skipped); deploy-health green on both. No PR since 10-16 touches Create [V gh]. Checked: unmarked `src/app/create/actions.test.ts`; nothing guards the absence of a check in Create (#580, #581); F082.1's new guard (#908) scans `members` and `groups` for role or mode columns, not the Create flow. Smoked: smoke-live has no route for /create or the draft Page publish card [V evals/screens/routes.ts]

criteria.text: Create's first question is what they're starting, not what they are; no self-classification anywhere in the flow
criteria.note: `/create` heading 'What are you starting?' with four answers (sell, gather, offer, Be creative) and 'This just gets things started' [V WhatAreYouStarting.tsx]. The answers are questions about the thing, worded by Don 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05, the newer rulings on this surface (F061 Rulings); the criterion's `/you/create` path is stale, the route is `/create` (#301). Built by #326, #364, #382 (the last two review-skipped). The retired `members.maker_mode_enabled` flag was dropped by #908 (migration 20261018160000). Checked: unmarked `WhatAreYouStarting.test.tsx`; nothing guards 'no self-classification' in Create's copy (#580, #581). Smoked: smoke-live has no route for /create [V evals/screens/routes.ts]

criteria.text: Page creation shows no legal or tax language and asks for no legal-entity information
criteria.note: No legal, tax, licence or entity words in Create, the Before-you-publish checklist or the rules text; no field asks for entity information [V grep src/components/create, src/lib/creator-rules.ts]. Built by #326 (Reviewed by) and #364 (review-skipped). Nothing guards it for Create: the only scan is F082.5's, over the rules block alone (#581).

criteria.text: Starting a second Page is one tap from the end of the first, and leaves the first unchanged
criteria.note: Create is a tab in the phone bottom nav (`md:hidden`) and 'Start something' sits on /you; `group.create` only inserts a new draft row [V BottomNav.tsx, you/page.tsx, create.ts]. Built by #58 (T158), whose body carries no `Reviewed by:`; deploy-health shows no run for its merge commit f79dd46 (it predates the workflow). No test of the one-tap path or of the first Page staying unchanged (#580). How a desktop-width member reaches Create is not read [A].

criteria.text: `/you/sell` redirects to Create, preserving any query string
criteria.note: `/you/sell/page.tsx` does `redirect('/create')` and drops the query string, so the venue 'host here' link's `?compose=gathering&location=…` is lost [V]. The criterion's target `/you/create` is stale; the route is `/create` (#301) and #579 keeps that target. The redirect half is built by #392 (`review-skipped`, deploy-health green); the query-string half is not, and no test asserts the redirect (#579).
